title: Context and non-empty graph present
description: The file has an @context that is not null and not [null], and an @graph holding at least one node. A document that uses TROV needs a context to say what trov: stands for, and in a `Tier 3 - TRACE-PERMISSIBLE-JSON-LD` document its nodes can only be in an @graph. A document with no context, or no nodes, uses no TROV and so does not use it correctly.
summary: The file has a non-null `@context` and an `@graph` holding at least one node

errorMessage.minItems: the @graph holds at least one node
